clue.text: Face right, removing top outside Brazilian city

explanation.surface: Instructions to turn right and confront something outside a Brazilian city.
explanation.walkthrough: Dexter is the heraldic term for the right-hand side.
explanation.definitionFit: A face is the outward surface of something, its outside appearance, as the exterior is.

clue.text: Tribe keeping noisy bats — 500 needed in fantastic place

explanation.surface: A tribe sheltering noisy bats needs five hundred of something in a strange spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bats' looks like the flying animals but is the slang adjective for mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloud-cuckoo-land, from Aristophanes' The Birds, is an imaginary realm of absurd unrealistic dreams.

explanation.definitionFit: Dragoons were mounted infantry, cavalry soldiers who originally fought on horseback with firearms.

clue.text: Saint Mark fully took offence at lawman's intolerance

explanation.surface: Saint Mark was thoroughly offended by a policeman's bigotry.
explanation.walkthrough: Eliot Ness was the US Prohibition agent who pursued Al Capone.
explanation.definitionFit: Being small-minded means having narrow, petty views, which is a form of intolerance of others.

clue.text: Metal having variable edge — not hard

clue.text: Red Queen's drink

Mary is the name of several English queens

explanation.definitionFit: A Bloody Mary is a cocktail of vodka and tomato juice, so it is a drink.

clue.text: Poet embracing one Latvian amateur

a Lett is a Latvian

clue.text: British in competition providing support

clue.text: Frosty relations? Liberal enters dispute about fishing limits

clue.text: Dandies supplied with Douro wine — deadly pursuit for some

clue.text: Similar to Spenser, Kelly moving around island

clue.text: Inspired Darwish pens literary collection
